    @pytest.mark.priority(24)
    @allure.title("Water Target Boundary Value Analysis (BVA)")
    @allure.description("Test boundary values for water target: oz (0, 1, 2, 499, 500, 501) and ml (0, 1, 50, 14737, 14787, 14788).")
    def test_24_water_target_bva(self):
        """Test boundary value analysis for water target input."""
        page = self.set_targets_page
    
        # Get unit configuration
        config = page.get_water_unit_config()
        max_value = config["max_value"]
        min_value = config["min_value"]
        increment = config["increment"]
    
        # BVA Test 1: Minimum boundary (min-1, min, min+increment)
        # Below-min input should never remain below configured minimum.
        page.input_box.fill(str(min_value - 1))
        val = int(page.input_box.input_value())
        assert val >= min_value, (
            f"Below min input ({min_value - 1}) should recover to >= {min_value}, got {val}"
        )
    
        # At minimum should be accepted.
        page.input_box.fill(str(min_value))
        val = int(page.input_box.input_value())
        assert val == min_value, f"At min should be {min_value}, got {val}"
    
        # Above minimum should be accepted.
        page.input_box.fill(str(min_value + increment))
        val = int(page.input_box.input_value())
        assert val == min_value + increment, f"Above min should be {min_value + increment}, got {val}"
    
        # BVA Test 2: Maximum boundary (max-increment, max, max+1)
        # Below maximum should be accepted.
        page.input_box.fill(str(max_value - increment))
        val = int(page.input_box.input_value())
        assert val == max_value - increment, f"Below max should be {max_value - increment}, got {val}"
    
        # At maximum should be accepted.
        page.input_box.fill(str(max_value))
        val = int(page.input_box.input_value())
